duplicate_charge.data_question: List all transactions in the window (txn_id, merchant, amount, currency, txn_ts, status, auth_code, channel). Return every merchant, not only the one named, so look-alike charges and pending holds can be compared.

unauthorized_transaction.data_question: List all transactions in the window (txn_id, merchant, amount, currency, txn_ts, status, channel, country). Include the full window, not only the disputed charge, so spending behaviour (usual country, merchants, amounts, hours) can be compared.

merchant_refund_missing.data_question: List purchases and refunds (txn_type PURCHASE and REFUND) in the window with txn_id, merchant, amount, currency, txn_ts, status, txn_type, so the original purchase and any matching credit can be paired.

recurring_after_cancellation.data_question: List recurring transactions (is_recurring = 1 or channel = 'RECURRING') in the window with txn_id, merchant, amount, currency, txn_ts, status, so the billing cadence can be analysed.

incorrect_amount.data_question: List transactions in the window for the merchant named by the customer (all merchants if none is named) with txn_id, merchant, amount, currency, txn_ts, status, auth_code, so the billed amount can be compared with the amount the customer expected.

pending_hold.data_question: List transactions in the window with status PENDING or POSTED (txn_id, merchant, amount, currency, txn_ts, status, auth_code) so pending authorisations can be matched with posted entries by auth_code.

fee_or_interest_dispute.requires_schema: txn_type values FEE and INTEREST (not in the demo table)
fee_or_interest_dispute.data_question: List transactions where txn_type is FEE or INTEREST, plus the purchases around them (txn_id, merchant, amount, currency, txn_ts, status, txn_type).

general_transaction_inquiry.data_question: List the most recent transactions in the window (txn_id, merchant, amount, currency, txn_ts, status, txn_type, channel, country), newest first.
